params.body:
`composer audit --locked` fails since advisory GHSA-w3p9-g4p2-h3rr (PKSA-h7cz-q7zq-mdkt, reported 2026-11-02) landed in the advisory database: phpseclib 4.0.0 to 4.0.2 accept an unbounded PBKDF iteration count when parsing encrypted keys, PFX or CMS, which lets a crafted input exhaust the CPU. The audit step stops every pull request at that point, including unrelated ones (#1090).

This bumps phpseclib/phpseclib 4.0.2 to 4.0.3 in `composer.lock` only, with `composer update phpseclib/phpseclib --minimal-changes --with-dependencies`. No other package moves and composer.json is untouched. 4.0.3 also drops the `phpseclib/bootstrap.php` autoload file upstream; nothing in this repo includes it.

After this lands, rerun the checks on #1090.
params.title: Bump phpseclib to 4.0.3 for the PBKDF iteration advisory
